SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT landing || '_' || boat) as boat_count,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / COUNT(*), 1) as yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 AND 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(*) as trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 278 AND 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 80;

SELECT 
  index_id,
  value,
  avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season >= 6
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  ROUND(wtmp_c, 1) as water_temp_c,
  ts_doy,
  ts_hour
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 5;
